subject: Add CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM to build scripts and submodules (#626)
reason: The change only adds -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 to build.sh and to the submodules' common CMake arguments so that newer CMake (4.x) accepts the submodules' old cmake_minimum_required declarations at configure time. It is a build/CI configuration change with no modification to any source file, compiler optimization, or linked code: the produced module binary's runtime behaviour (commands, replies, indexing, persistence) is identical, so there is no reachable behaviour change for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
